source_metadata.question:
A cylindrical barrel with radius $4$ feet and height $10$ feet is full of water. A solid cube with side length $8$ feet is set into the barrel so that the diagonal of the cube is vertical. The volume of water thus displaced is $v$ cubic feet. Find $v^2$.

source_metadata.question:
A square with perimeter $48 \mathrm{~cm}$ is cut into two equally big pieces with one cut. They are fitted together to make a rectangle as shown in the diagram. How big is the perimeter of that rectangle?

target.left_evidence: The dotted edge running from the rear interior cube vertex up toward the top cube vertex.
target.right_evidence: The horizontal dashed divider inside the left square, before the right-pointing transformation arrow.
target.left_meaning: It represents an edge on the back of the cube, hidden in the solid view.
target.right_meaning: It marks the partition of the square into the pieces used to form the rectangle.
target.reason: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The right dashes partition the square in a before-and-after piece rearrangement diagram. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
